profile.name: Siddarth Mally
profile.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
profile.bio: Cybersecurity GRC and Third-Party Risk Management professional with 4+ years of experience conducting vendor risk assessments, security due diligence, inherent risk analysis, and remediation tracking across financial services and healthcare environments. Experienced in evaluating third-party security controls using SOC 1/SOC 2, SIG, CAIQ, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, HITRUST, PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA to strengthen governance, compliance, and enterprise risk management. Skilled in ServiceNow, One Trust, Zen GRC, SharePoint, Confluence, risk register management, cloud security assessments, IAM, SSO, MFA, vulnerability management, BCP/DR, and executive risk reporting, with hands-on experience supporting audit readiness and regulatory compliance. Strong collaborator with the ability to translate technical risks into business-focused insights while leveraging enterprise-approved AI tools to improve assessment efficiency, documentation quality, and third-party security governance.
